releaseNotes:
What's New in Version 2.9.2 🚀
- All-Time Best Day & Best Week Highlights: Track your highest focus hours across all time with clean pinned highlights and enhanced milestone stats.
- Dynamic Goal Reached Indicator: Goal Reached status badge turns emerald green when your daily focus goal is accomplished.
- Stylized Vector Donut Toggle: Modern crisp vector donut icon in settings replacing default emoji.
- Brand & UI Refinements: Updated Team JAI splash branding, perfected weekly trend row colorings, and enhanced highlights layout.
